title: Open Horizon
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume song, not an intro. Full kick, bass, chords and melodic hook from the first beat through the last beat. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo MELODIC TRANCE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 146 BPM in 4/4. Solid four-on-the-floor kick on every quarter beat, clean snare or clap on two and four, bright eighth hats, rolling bass, warm suspended chords and a distinct short plucked arpeggio attack on each quarter beat. Signature hook: five rising notes pause for one beat and resolve into a two-note answer in a different octave; a long luminous pad supports but does not obscure beats. At 64 seconds shift chord roots and invert the answer while keeping loudness and groove stable, with no low-energy middle. Melodic motion and fresh second half, no exact repeated half. No quiet intro, breakdown, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, harsh distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation. No late breakdown or outro: the last 32 seconds must keep the same full drums, bass, chords and lead as the first 96 seconds.
cover_prompt: Original comic-print cover: two offset horizontal frequency ribbons open apart to frame a narrow cyan void, coral pulse at their vanishing point; no landscape, sun, moon, planet or text.
og_prompt: Horizontal duohertz card with opening frequency ribbons on right and Open Horizon title on left, high-contrast dark editorial graphic and restrained halftone.
